title: Crypto Market Brief: Why $BTC, $ETH, $SOL and $WLFI Are Under Pressure, and What Would Change It
subTitle:
Executive summary
November has been a difficult month for crypto. This brief looks at four assets ($BTC, $ETH, $SOL and $WLFI) through three lenses: price, capital flows and macro. Four takeaways stand out:
1. All four assets are lower over the past ten days. $WLFI has fallen most (-13.2%), $BTC and $ETH about 10%, and $SOL least (-6.7%).
2. Each asset trades in the bottom third of its 10-day range, and $WLFI sits closest to its low.
3. Capital is still leaving. US spot $BTC ETFs are on track for their worst month on record (about -$4.94B), but the daily pace of outflows slowed this week.
4. The next catalyst is macro. Markets price a roughly 90% chance of a Fed rate hike on December 9, so the Fed's tone may matter more than the hike itself.
1. The market in one picture

Exhibit 1 indexes each asset to 100 on November 15. Two patterns stand out. First, the decline was broad: all four assets fell together, which points to market-wide forces rather than coin-specific news. Second, the sharpest drop came on November 20, when $BTC lost about 5% and $ETH about 8% in a single day. Every rebound since then has been sold.
$SOL has held up relatively better, while $WLFI has drifted lower steadily, including on days when the rest of the market bounced.

2. Where prices sit now

Exhibit 2 shows where each asset trades within its own 10-day range, from the low (0%) to the high (100%). All four sit in the bottom third:
- $BTC at ~$58,600, 32% of its $55,130-$66,132 range
- $ETH at ~$1,646, 33% of its $1,538-$1,867 range
- $SOL at ~$67.86, 22% of its $64.87-$78.48 range
- $WLFI at ~$0.0408, 12% of its $0.0398-$0.0479 range
The daily charts on Binance tell a consistent technical story. $ETH, $SOL and $WLFI all trade below their 7-day and 25-day moving averages, and $ETH and $WLFI are pressing against their lower Bollinger Bands. These readings often appear when selling is stretched in the short term, but on their own they are not a signal that the trend has turned.
3. Follow the money: ETF flows

Spot ETFs are the clearest window into institutional demand, and Exhibit 3 shows a clear split.
Bitcoin: Spot $BTC ETFs lost about $1.3B, $1.1B and $1.79B in the first three weeks of November, then another $801M in just two sessions this week. Six straight days of outflows have pushed the November total to about -$4.94B, above June's previous record of -$4.51B. Scale matters, though: total ETF assets are still about $72B, and cumulative net inflows since launch are about $52B. This is a heavy redemption wave, not an exit from the product. Tuesday's outflow (-$231.6M) was also about 59% smaller than Monday's (-$569.7M).
Ethereum: $ETH ETFs posted three straight weekly outflows of about $365M, $399M and $314M.
Solana: $SOL ETFs are the exception. After six weeks of outflows, they took in +$4.38M in the week to November 21, the first positive week since October 9. Monday reverted to a -$3.8M outflow, so the signal is early and fragile.
WLFI: $WLFI has no spot ETF. Its closest equivalent is the supply of USD1, World Liberty Financial's stablecoin, which fell about 11% in one week to below $3B in mid-November.
4. Asset by asset
Bitcoin ($BTC ~$58,600)
What happened: Ten days of mostly lower closes, with a low near $55,130 on November 21 and a failed bounce to $64,600 on November 23.
Why it matters: One research estimate puts $BTC about 25% below the average entry price of ETF buyers. That gives some holders a reason to sell into rallies.
Signpost: A daily close below $58,000 would bring the $55,000 area back into focus.
Ethereum ($ETH ~$1,646)
What happened: Down 7.5% over 7 days and 30% over 30 days. Price sits below its 7-, 25- and 99-day averages ($1,660 / $1,695 / $1,838) and near its lower Bollinger Band (~$1,631). MACD remains negative.
Why it matters: $ETH has fallen more than $BTC on most down days this month. It is trading as a higher-volatility version of the same risk-off move.
Signpost: Holding the lower band versus revisiting the $1,538 low.
Solana ($SOL ~$67.86)
What happened: Down 5.8% over 7 days, 33.5% over 30 days and 49.3% over one year. It trades below its 7- and 25-day averages (~$70.38 / ~$80.01), with a recent low of $64.87. The daily MACD histogram has turned slightly positive while both MACD lines remain well below zero.
Why it matters: Downside momentum is slowing, and ETF demand briefly turned positive. These are early signs, not a reversal.
Signpost: A second positive ETF week, and whether $64.87 holds.

World Liberty Financial ($WLFI ~$0.0408)
What happened: The token trades on the WLFI/USD1 pair in a $0.0399-$0.0416 daily range. It sits below its 7-, 25- and 99-day averages ($0.0429 / $0.0461 / $0.0538), on its lower Bollinger Band, and just above a recent low of $0.0398.
Why it matters: $WLFI's fundamentals are tied to USD1. The buyback program announced in early November is funded partly by income from USD1 reserves, but it has no disclosed size or schedule. USD1 supply has been shrinking, and Ripple's RLUSD has reportedly overtaken it.
Signpost: USD1 supply data and any buyback disclosure.
5. The macro layer: the Fed
The Federal Reserve meets on December 8-9. Futures markets assign roughly a 90% probability to a 25 basis-point hike, which would take the policy rate to 4.00-4.25%. Markets also price about a 60% chance of another hike in January. Because the December hike is largely expected, the signal that could move markets is the guidance: whether the Fed points to more hikes or a pause. Weakness in AI-related equities has added to the risk-off mood, and the Crypto Fear & Greed Index stands at 13 (Extreme Fear).
US PCE inflation and GDP data due today will shape those expectations.

6. Three scenarios

Exhibit 4 sets out three conditional scenarios. The base case assumes outflows keep shrinking and the Fed delivers a hike with neutral guidance. In that case, $BTC would likely range between about $58K and $64K, and the other assets would hold their recent lows. The downside case, hot inflation data plus hawkish guidance, points to retests of those lows. The upside case requires ETF flows to turn positive for several days. These are frameworks for thinking about the next few weeks, not predictions. NFA.
7. Signposts to watch
- Daily ETF flows: is the outflow pace still shrinking?
- $BTC daily close relative to $58,000
- A second positive ETF week for $SOL
- USD1 supply and buyback disclosures for $WLFI
- Fed guidance on December 9
Terms used in this brief
- ETF net flow: money entering minus money leaving exchange-traded funds that hold the asset.
- Moving average (MA): the average price over a set number of days; trading below it signals a weak trend.
- Bollinger Band: a volatility band around the 20-day average; the lower band often marks short-term stretched selling.
- MACD: a momentum indicator; values below zero indicate downside momentum.
- Basis point (bp): 0.01 percentage point; 25 bp = 0.25%.

Which signpost would change your view first: ETF flows, the Fed's tone, or a key price level?

Not financial advice. Always do your own research.

Only half an hour until the PCE release, and $ETH $SOL $NVDAB  are all near their 7-day lows

First, here are three sets of numbers I worked out myself. ETH is at 1,646, with a 7-day high of 1,845 and a low of 1,538—down 10.8% from the high and just 7.0% above the low. SOL is at 67.8, in a 7-day range of 64.87 to 78.48, just 4.5% above the low. NVDAB, the leading chip-sector token, is at 146.8, in a 7-day range of 124.9 to 171.5, and down 6.8% over the past 24 hours.

Two things are dominating the discussion today: tonight’s core PCE release at 21:30 and tariff rumors. The core annual inflation rate is expected to rise from 3.1% to 3.2%, and a 25-basis-point rate hike in December is almost fully priced in. The chip sector fell 7.88% the previous day, the Nasdaq dropped 1.48%, and crypto just got caught in the sell-off.

There are basically three schools of thought. One says an in-line reading would be mildly positive: oil prices are falling, and an inflation turning point is near. Another says the data has already been priced in, and the real wildcard is the month-over-month core figure—if it tops 0.3%, some will call for a 50-basis-point hike. Others are watching SOL, saying the long-short ratio has reached 3.78, with longs crowded on one side; if prices fall, it could trigger a long squeeze.

My take: an in-line reading doesn’t necessarily mean prices will rise. ETFs saw net outflows of $4.71 billion in November, and buyers haven’t returned. The first candle after the data will probably whipsaw in both directions.

What to do: Don’t chase trades in the half-hour before or after the data release. For ETH, 1,635 is the line between bulls and bears; holding above it would offer some breathing room. If it breaks, watch the previous low at 1,538. For SOL, don’t buy if it breaks below 65 on heavy volume, and don’t chase a rebound if it can’t get past 70.9. For NVDAB, 146 is today’s low; if it doesn’t hold, watch 125. A recovery isn’t worth discussing until it gets back above 160. Keep positions light and set your stops in advance.

Have you already positioned yourself, or are you keeping your powder dry until after the data comes out? I’ll keep reviewing the market after the PCE release over the next few days. Follow me if you find this useful.

🐋 $ETH  All-platform account long/short ratio: 2.19 (long 68.7% / short 31.3%), compared with 2.18 an hour ago.
To see how big players are positioning, many people look at the long/short ratio, but the two metrics measure different things.
The total amount of long and short positions across the entire market is always equal. A bullish all-platform account long/short ratio only means that long positions are spread across more accounts, while short positions are held by a small number of accounts.
When the long/short ratio and funding rate point in the same direction, the signal of concentrated positioning is clearer. When they conflict, don't rush to a conclusion.
Don't change your pace because of a single number, and never use borrowed money to test a theory.

【Today: $ 1644; about $ 1800 a week ago. I won’t make up a figure for a month ago just yet.】

ETH fell another 8.6% this week, and the Fear & Greed Index is just 13. When prices are this weak, the easiest mistake to make is to equate “it’s fallen a lot” with “the bottom is in.”

I’m more interested in another shift: ETH is moving from being a trading asset to a potential tool on institutional balance sheets. New CFTC guidance allows exchanges and clearing organizations to count BTC, ETH, and stablecoins toward their 12-month operating-cost buffers.

Think of it this way: it’s like a company keeping a “cash-accessible safety reserve” on its books to cover day-to-day operations. ETH now has a chance to become one of the assets in that reserve, rather than just sitting in a trading account exposed to price swings.

What does this mean in practice? Trading venues, clearinghouses, and custodians will be affected. Holding compliant ETH could ease some liquidity-management pressures, while market makers and businesses involved in collateralized lending and stablecoins may reassess how they use ETH. The business logic makes sense, but don’t interpret “eligible to count” as “you can sell coins at any time to make payroll.” It simply gives ETH a new use; it doesn’t mean institutions are already making sustained, real-money purchases.

So when it comes to investing, I’d first look at three things: whether institutions are actually allocating to ETH, whether it can be held and transferred at low cost, and whether it can reliably provide liquidity—rather than calling a reversal based on a single regulatory headline.

Remember: being a buffer doesn’t mean being an ATM. ETH’s true bottom won’t be confirmed by slogans, but by capital flows and real-world use.

Which step in this institutional adoption narrative do you think will become reality first?

#ETH #加密分析 #BTC #MarketInsights

【今天$ 1644，一周前约$ 1800，一个月前的数字先不硬编】

这周ETH又跌了8.6%，恐惧贪婪指数只有13。价格弱成这样，市场最容易犯的错，就是把“跌得多”直接等同于“底到了”。

我更关心另一个变化：ETH正在从交易资产，变成机构资产负债表里的候选工具。CFTC新指引允许交易所和清算机构把BTC、ETH、稳定币计入12个月运营成本缓冲。

打个比方，这就像公司账上要留一笔“活期保险箱”，应付日常运营。现在ETH有机会成为保险箱里的资产之一，而不是只能躺在交易账户里等波动。

落到实处意味着什么？交易场所、清算所和托管机构会受影响：持有合规ETH，可能缓解部分流动性管理压力；做市商、抵押借贷和稳定币业务也会重新评估ETH的用途。商业逻辑是通的，但别把“允许计入”理解成“可以随时卖币发工资”。它只是获得了一种新用途，不等于机构已经真金白银持续买进。

所以投资上，我会先看三件事：机构有没有实际配置、能否低成本持有与转移、ETH能否稳定提供流动性，而不是只看一条监管新闻就喊反转。

记住这一点：能当缓冲垫，不等于能当提款机。ETH真正的底部，不靠口号确认，要靠资金和用途确认。

你觉得这波机构化叙事，哪一步最先真落地？

What is blind signing? Why shouldn’t you sign if you can’t understand what you’re signing?
EIP-712 defines a format for signing structured data. Wallets that support this standard can display each item you’re about to sign, making it much easier to understand than a string of hashes.
Older signing methods like eth_sign can sign any hash, which could represent a transaction. Some wallets have already disabled this by default.
When managing funds, the most important thing to watch for is this: if the wallet’s transaction simulation shows that assets will be transferred, but you didn’t intend to do that, reject it outright.

什么是盲签？为什么看不懂就别签？
EIP-712 定义了结构化数据的签名格式，支持这一标准的钱包能把要签的内容逐项显示出来，比一串哈希好懂很多。
eth_sign 这种老式签名能对任意哈希签名，签下的可能就是一笔交易，一些钱包已经默认关闭它。

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math of Going All-In—Will You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% on a win and losing 50% on a loss. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in each time, here’s the long-term expectation: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
That looks like a positive expectation. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean a 75% loss, and you’d need a 300% gain to break even.
A positive-expectation strategy + going all-in = a high probability of ruin. This is gambler’s ruin playing out in crypto
every day.

With the same strategy, risk only 20% of your bankroll each time: two losses in a row = -18%, barely a dent,
while still capturing the long-term expected return. The strategy hasn’t changed—only the position size, but the outcome is completely different.

$AAOIB: How Volume Shapes Moves at Any Price

Why does $AAOIB drop hourly while its volume stays above baseline? The observation invites a question about whether high participation can offset price level differences. 

The primary asset shows an hourly down direction with 2.28x baseline volume. A peer at a similar price, $ETH, also moves down but its volume is not above baseline, suggesting a weaker participation signal. In contrast, $MANTRA climbs hourly and its volume exceeds baseline, illustrating that strong volume can accompany an opposite price path. 

One possible mechanism is that relative volume reflects the proportion of market activity concentrated in a single candle, regardless of the asset's absolute price. When 2.28x baseline is high, even a low‑price asset like $AAOIB can experience a meaningful move because many traders are engaged relative to recent activity. Conversely, a high‑price asset with modest relative volume may see a muted reaction. 

A counterexample would be a scenario where $AAOIB's volume spikes but the price remains flat, indicating that volume alone does not guarantee direction. 

To reassess this idea, monitor the next closed hourly candle: if the down move continues alongside sustained above‑baseline volume, the participation hypothesis gains support; if volume recedes or the price stabilises, the link weakens.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

For a wider view: $ETH has hourly direction down and volume not above its baseline; $MANTRA has hourly direction up and volume above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.

A whale withdrew $15.01 million worth of coins, and you’re ready to chase? There’s a trade missing in between.

Ember’s tracking post mentioned that one address withdrew a cumulative 4.16 trillion $PEPE over 8 days, worth roughly $15.01 million according to the post. This can show where the coins were transferred, but on its own it can’t prove how much was just bought, let alone whether this was simply a change in custody.

When I look at this kind of on-chain news, I separate out three questions: Did the transfer happen? When did the purchase happen? Does this address have hedging positions elsewhere? If the original post doesn’t provide the answers, I leave those questions open.

Likewise, when watching on-chain whales like $ETH , don’t see the word “withdrawal” and assume it means a buy. Withdrawing coins changes their custody location; new buying means spending on the order book. Treating the former as the latter is the easiest way to end up chasing the price while someone else is just moving coins.
#PEPE #ETH #OnChainData

title: 冷钱包的漏洞，藏了五年才被发现
subTitle:
只支持 BTC 的硬件钱包 Coldcard 最近公开了一份事后复盘，承认一个问题被漏掉了五年多（Decrypt、Cointelegraph 11 月 25 日报道）。

问题出在随机数上。按复盘的说法，设备里本该使用硬件随机数生成器，实际却有软件版本在替它工作，时间超过五年。这期间至少 15 次安全审查都没有发现。厂商 Coinkite 解释了为什么多年的检查会漏掉它，至于是否赔偿受影响的用户，目前还没有决定。

随机数为什么这么要紧？私钥就是一串无法预测的数字，它靠随机性来保证没人能猜到。随机性不够，私钥之间就可能出现规律，理论上可以被猜测或复现。硬件钱包的安全承诺，很大一部分就建立在随机数足够随机这个前提上。

这件事有三点值得普通用户记住。

一是冷钱包不等于绝对安全。它把私钥离线保存，挡住了网络攻击，但设备自身的固件和芯片仍然是信任链上的一环。

二是审查次数多不等于没有漏洞。至少 15 次审查漏掉同一个问题，说明安全审查只能降低出问题的概率，不能消除它。

三是单一设备不要放全部资产。分成几份，放在不同厂商甚至不同类型的钱包里，一处出问题不至于全损。

如果你手里正好有这个品牌的设备，建议直接去看厂商的官方说明，确认自己的设备是否在受影响范围内，再决定要不要迁移资产。

（信息来自 Decrypt 与 Cointelegraph 报道，不构成投资建议）

#BTC #ETH #安全

translatedData.title: A Cold Wallet Vulnerability Went Undetected for Five Years
translatedData.subTitle:
Coldcard, a hardware wallet that supports only BTC, recently published a postmortem admitting that an issue had gone unnoticed for more than five years (reported by Decrypt and Cointelegraph on November 25).

The problem was with the random number generation. According to the postmortem, the device was supposed to use a hardware random number generator, but a software version had actually been doing the job for more than five years. During that time, at least 15 security audits failed to detect it. The manufacturer, Coinkite, explained why it had escaped years of checks, but has not yet decided whether to compensate affected users.

Clickbait headlines are shouting “ETH treasury companies are collapsing,” but this SEC filing is actually about something else.

Between November 15 and 23, Bit Digital (BTBT) sold 29,825 ETH at an average price of about $1,676, raising roughly $50 million—and kept none of it. Every dollar went toward repaying principal on its secured loan from Galaxy Digital. The outstanding balance was cut directly from $100 million to $50 million, halving its leverage overnight.

Pay attention to the time frame: nine days, 29,825 ETH, $ETH. This isn’t the pattern of a panic sell-off, but a clean, deliberate debt paydown.

The structure is even more worth examining. The remaining $50 million loan is secured by 69,089 LsETH, which has already been included in its reported ETH-equivalent holdings. In other words, this staked position isn’t “freely circulating” inventory; it’s locked into the debt structure.

As of now, Bit Digital holds approximately 134,532 ETH and equivalents, including 36,811 ETH staked natively.

Where did the money the market is overlooking actually go? The $100 million Galaxy loan was originally provided as bridge financing for projects including the NC-1 data center operated by its subsidiary WhiteFiber (WYFI), and is expected to be fully repaid in Q2 2027.

So don’t rush to label ETH treasury companies as “selling coins to prop themselves up.” When a company chooses to repay with spot assets instead of rolling over its loan, and proactively lowers its collateral ratio, it looks more like it’s making room on its balance sheet for the future.

The story of a treasury company has never been just about “how much it holds,” but about “how much it owes, how much it has pledged, and when it will pay it off.” Those three ledgers reveal more about risk than holdings figures do.

$BTBT #ETH

content:
标题党都在喊"ETH 财库公司要崩了"，但这份 SEC 文件讲的其实是另一回事。

Bit Digital（BTBT）在 11 月 15 日至 23 日之间，用 29,825 枚 ETH、均价约 1676 美元，套现约 5000 万美元，一分钱没留——全额拿去还 Galaxy Digital 的有担保借款本金。借款余额从 1 亿美元直接砍到 5000 万，杠杆瞬间腰斩。

注意时间窗口：9 天，29,825 枚，$ETH。这不是恐慌性抛售的曲线，而是一次干净利落的、有计划的债务去化。

更值得琢磨的是结构。剩余那 5000 万美元借款，押了 69,089 枚 LsETH 作抵押，并且已经计入它披露的 ETH 等价物持仓。也就是说，这部分质押头寸不是"自由浮动"的筹码，而是锁在债务结构里的。

截至目前 Bit Digital 持有约 134,532 枚 ETH 及等价物，其中原生质押 36,811 枚。

真正被市场忽略的钱去哪了？这 1 亿美元 Galaxy 借款，原本是垫给子公司 WhiteFiber（WYFI）做 NC-1 数据中心等项目的过桥资金，预计 2027 年 Q2 全部偿还。

所以别急着给 ETH 财库公司贴"卖币撑盘"的标签。当一家公司选择用现货偿还而非展期续贷、把抵押率主动压低，这更像是在给未来的资产负债表腾空间。

财库公司的故事，从来不是"持有多少"，而是"欠多少、押多少、什么时候清"。这三本账，比持仓数字更能说明风险。

translatedData.content:
$12 billion in net redemptions over 30 days: stablecoins are shrinking, and buying pressure is too

According to Kaiko, over the 30 days through November 13, 11 stablecoins saw net redemptions of about $12 billion, with the circulating supply of USDT and USDC each falling by roughly 4%. Analyst Andrew Yang believes this reflects money leaving the crypto market, not investors rotating between assets within the market.

Buying power is also dwindling: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw outflows over the same period, while expectations of tighter Fed policy grew; average daily trading volume in USDT pairs was about half the 2025 average; and the value of orders placed by Bitcoin market makers within 1% of the market price fell by about 15% in a month, though it actually rose 9% when measured in BTC.

By network, Ethereum accounted for nearly 90% of the contraction, while Tron was down just 1.4%. This quarter, average daily on-chain transfers of USDT and USDC were about $157 billion, above the 2025 average of $130 billion.

Compared with 2022, this contraction is much smaller and slower: after November 13, total supply fell by only another 0.4%, while USDC even edged back up. But Julio Moreno of CryptoQuant says USDT is still seeing its largest decline since 2022, with its market cap shrinking by $9 billion over 60 days. Is this contraction a sign that money is truly leaving the market, or has it simply moved into ETFs?

#BTC #ETH

30天净赎回120亿美元，稳定币在缩，买盘也在缩

Kaiko 统计，截至11月13日的30天里，11 种稳定币净赎回约 120 亿美元，USDT 与 USDC 流通量各降约 4%。分析师 Andrew Yang 认为，这是资金离开加密市场，不是在自己人之间换仓。

买盘弹药跟着变少：美国现货比特币 ETF 同期在流出，美联储收紧预期升温；USDT 交易对日均成交约为 2025 年平均的一半；比特币做市商挂在市价 1% 内的订单金额一个月降约 15%，按 BTC 计价反而大 9%。

结构上，近 90% 的缩水来自以太坊，波场只降 1.4%；本季 USDT、USDC 链上转账日均约 1570 亿美元，高于 2025 年均值 1300 亿。

相比 2022 年这轮小得多也慢：11月13日后总供应只再降 0.4%，USDC 还略回升；但 CryptoQuant 的 Julio Moreno 说，USDT 仍是 2022 年以来最大降幅，市值 60 天缩 90 亿美元。这轮缩水，是资金真离场，还是只是搬去了 ETF？

The Fed only needs to shift its long-term inflation target from 2% to a long-term path of around 3%, and many of the macroeconomic tensions the world is facing today could ease.

Government debt, industrial restructuring, the energy transition, and AI infrastructure development are all driving up long-term capital spending, yet the Fed still constrains the entire monetary system with a relatively conventional 2% inflation target.

This may be something the United States is doing but dares not publicly admit.

Once admitted publicly, the capital markets would immediately price in the Fed’s intention to dilute debt through inflation.

At that point, inflation expectations, Treasury term premiums, and the dollar’s risk premium could all be repriced, potentially pushing up the U.S. government’s long-term borrowing costs instead.

So what the United States may really need is not to publicly change its 2% inflation target, but to gradually accommodate a long-term inflation environment of around 3% through its actual monetary policy.

This is an extremely subtle monetary policy adjustment, and it may be the only way to explain the divergent macroeconomic conditions around the world over the past few years and the instability of Fed policy.

This may also explain why Wall Street has accumulated so much Bitcoin over the past few years. At its core, this reflects an implicit acceptance of the “Fed’s ghost policy”: the global economy is shifting from an era of globalization marked by low inflation and low capital spending to a new economic cycle characterized by high capital spending and high nominal growth.

Looking back over the past few years, the Fed has indeed been pursuing a ghost policy based on a long-term inflation path of around 3%.

As for the 2% long-term inflation target, the Fed has been dangling it in front of the world like a carrot. The ghost policy is what really exists…

Ukraine’s Virtual Assets Law Establishes a Regulatory Framework

Ukraine’s efforts to establish a legal framework for virtual assets involved several stages, including parliamentary approval, presidential signature, and preparations for supporting regulations. In September 2021, Ukraine’s parliament passed the Virtual Assets Law. Reports indicate that 276 of the 376 sitting members voted in favor, while 6 voted against. The bill was subsequently amended and reviewed again. In March 2022, the Ukrainian president signed the legislation, formally establishing the legal status, classification, ownership rights, and regulatory arrangements for the virtual asset market.

A key distinction is that legalization does not mean granting cryptocurrencies legal tender status. The law defines cryptocurrencies and other virtual assets as intangible goods, allowing them to circulate and related businesses to operate within a regulatory framework. However, they are not accepted as legal tender and cannot be directly exchanged for other goods or services. In other words, the framework focuses on recognizing asset rights and market access, rather than replacing the national monetary system with cryptocurrency.

In terms of its rules, the law clarifies that market participants may determine the value of virtual assets themselves, open bank accounts for transaction settlements, and seek judicial protection of related rights. It also imposes anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing requirements on service providers. Regulatory responsibilities involve the Ministry of Digital Transformation, the National Bank, and the securities market regulator, among others. The National Bank has a corresponding regulatory role for financial virtual assets backed by currency, while the securities market regulator takes the lead when the underlying assets are securities or derivatives.

The framework may affect the crypto market first by reducing uncertainty around compliant operations. Clear rules for the registration, licensing, and oversight of trading platforms, custodians, and other service providers would provide an institutional basis for account and settlement cooperation between traditional banks and crypto businesses. In addition, recognition of ownership rights and access to judicial protection can bring some on-chain activity within a legal system that supports accountability and redress. Related amendments to tax and civil laws will determine whether the framework can develop into a complete market operating system.

It is important to distinguish between the implementation of a law and the elimination of market risks. Asset price volatility, platform operating risks, the effectiveness of anti-money laundering enforcement, and the efficiency of regulatory coordination will continue to affect outcomes. The editorial view is that Ukraine’s case is significant mainly as an example of a regulatory approach: managing the market through ownership rights, market access, and compliance obligations without recognizing cryptocurrency as a legal means of payment. For the industry, regulatory clarity is generally more worth watching over time than policy statements alone.

#乌克兰通过虚拟资产合法化法案 #BTC #ETH #BNB

content:
乌克兰虚拟资产法确立监管框架

乌克兰围绕虚拟资产建立法律框架的进程，经历了议会表决、总统签署及配套制度准备等多个环节。2021年9月，乌克兰议会通过“虚拟资产”法；报道显示，376名现任议员中有276票赞成、6票反对。该法案随后经调整并再次审议，乌克兰总统于2022年3月签署相关法案，使虚拟资产市场的法律地位、分类、所有权及监管安排获得制度化确认。

核心边界在于，合法化并不等同于赋予加密货币法定货币地位。法案将加密货币等虚拟资产界定为无形商品，允许其在监管框架内流通和开展相关业务，但不接受其作为法定支付手段，也不允许直接兑换其他商品或服务。换言之，这套制度的重点是确认资产权利和市场准入，而非以加密货币替代本国货币体系。

从规则设计看，法案一方面明确市场参与者可自行确定虚拟资产价值、开设用于交易结算的银行账户，并就相关权利寻求司法保护；另一方面对服务提供商提出反洗钱及反恐融资要求。监管职责则涉及数字化转型部门、国家银行、证券市场监管机构等。对于以货币作支撑的金融虚拟资产，国家银行承担相应监管角色；底层资产为证券或衍生品时，则由证券市场监管机构主导。

这一安排对加密市场的影响路径，首先在于降低合规经营的不确定性。交易平台、托管及其他服务机构若有清晰的注册、许可和监督规则，传统银行与加密企业之间的账户、结算协作才具备制度基础。其次，产权确认和司法保护有助于将部分链上活动纳入可追责、可处理的法律体系。税法和民法等配套修订，则决定框架能否进一步形成完整的市场运行闭环。

需要区分的是，法律落地不代表市场风险消失。资产价格波动、平台运营风险、反洗钱执行质量及监管协调效率，仍会影响实际效果。编辑观察认为，乌克兰案例的意义更多在于展示一种监管取向：在不承认加密货币为法定支付工具的前提下，通过权属、准入和合规义务来管理市场。对行业而言，制度清晰度通常比单纯的政策表态更值得持续关注。

My stance is cautious: funding conditions remain weak, and “earning staking rewards” should not be taken to mean that ETFs will continue accumulating ETH. Farside’s data on U.S. Ethereum funds shows combined net outflows of $64.1 million on November 24, including $37.8 million from BlackRock’s ETHA and $25.8 million from ETHB, which has a staking arrangement. Fidelity’s FETH saw inflows of $3.3 million, while other products had smaller changes. These figures are the combined subscriptions and redemptions across the funds on the previous trading day—not real-time on-chain selling today. Nor can ETHB’s outflows be taken to mean that validators are immediately exiting en masse.

BlackRock’s official ETHB materials state that the fund aims to track the price of Ethereum while seeking staking rewards on a portion of its holdings. Its quarterly filing with the SEC also says the manager plans to retain an un-staked ETH reserve to meet anticipated redemptions and manage the liquidity risks associated with staking. In other words, net outflows of fund shares, spot asset management by the custodian, and the validator exit queue are three separate stages. The market may price in potential supply pressure ahead of time, but these should not be presented as sell orders occurring at the same moment and for the same amount. If redemptions continue to grow and liquidity reserves prove insufficient, we can then watch to see whether unstaking becomes necessary and whether the risk spreads further.

$BLUR: Why Massive Volume Sometimes Produces Almost Zero Price Progress

Does strong volume always push $BLUR higher? The chart shows an hourly up direction while volume sits at 2.87x baseline, a situation that challenges the common belief that volume guarantees price advance.

**The question**
Many traders assume that a surge in buying effort must translate into a comparable price gain. The observation of an up move with volume merely above baseline suggests a possible absorption effect, where market participants absorb the effort without allowing the price to travel far.

**Evidence and an alternative**
The hourly direction is up and the relative volume is 2.87x baseline. RSI 69.1 indicates modest momentum, while the price change over the last hourly window is 7.52566%. One interpretation is that buyers are present but the market finds enough supply to soak the effort, limiting the net move. An alternative view could be that the volume increase is not significant enough to overcome existing resistance levels, so the price stalls despite the directional bias.

**A practical self‑check**
Monitor the next closed hourly candle. If the direction remains up and the relative volume rises further above baseline, the absorption hypothesis weakens. Conversely, if volume stays near baseline while price stays flat, the hypothesis gains support. This simple check helps reassess the link between effort and result without implying a guaranteed outcome.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

Last time, I said I wouldn’t treat the area around 1,538 as a confirmed new bottom. First, I wanted to see a daily close hold above 1,538.00 and reclaim 1,711.08; the weekly candle close back above 1,835.35 at 08:00 on 11/23, avoiding a seventh consecutive down week; clear net inflows into ETFs, with ETHA also turning to inflows. Here’s what happened: the four daily candles for 11/21, 11/22, 11/23, and 11/24 closed at 1,685.63, 1,724.33, 1,710.65, and 1,680.11, respectively, all holding above 1,538.00. Only the 11/22 close was above 1,711.08; the 11/23 and 11/24 closes were both below it. The weekly candle for the week of 11/16 closed at 1,724.33 at 08:00 on 11/23, below its open of 1,835.35, completing a seventh consecutive down week. At 21:56 on the evening of 11/23, Jin10 reported that Nvidia’s board had reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. ETH began to rally around the same time, spiking to 1,845.07 at 22:27. As of 19:25 on 11/25 (Taipei time), the price had fallen back to around 1,645, with today’s intraday low at 1,633.11.

Binance spot data (19:25 on 11/25, Taipei time): ETH around 1,645, down 2.4% over 24 hours, in a range of 1,633.11–1,708.16; BTC around 58,731 (-1.6%), SOL around 67.64 (-3.6%). This week, ETH opened at 1,724.34 and is currently down about 4.6%; its high for the week was 1,845.07 at 22:27 on the evening of 11/23. The current price is about 7.0% above 1,538.00, but about 3.9% below 1,711.08. Today’s daily candle won’t close until 08:00 on 11/26.

The flows haven’t followed through. Farside shows that U.S. spot ETH ETFs saw net outflows for seven consecutive trading days from 11/16 through 11/24: $8.4 million, $29.1 million, $39.8 million, $131.2 million, $97.3 million, $84.9 million, and $64.1 million, respectively, for a total of about $454.8 million. When ETH spiked to 1,845.07 intraday on 11/23, ETFs still saw $84.9 million in net outflows. Across the fourteen trading days from 11/5 to 11/24, net outflows totaled about $1.0469 billion; the only day with net inflows was 11/13, at $2.3 million. On the derivatives side, Binance ETH perpetual open interest increased over the past 24 hours from around 2.347 million at 17:00 on 11/24 to around 2.395 million at 17:00 on 11/25, up about 2.1%, but still below the roughly 2.495 million recorded at 16:00 on 11/20. Over the same period, the price fell from around 1,693 to around 1,641. The latest funding rate (16:00 on 11/25) was +0.0042%, still close to zero.

What does this mean? (The following is my own inference.)
The price rebounded from 1,538 to 1,845.07 and even moved above 1,835.35 intraday, but this looks more like a recovery driven by the pickup in risk appetite on the evening of 11/23 than fresh allocation buying. ETFs were still seeing net outflows on the day of the spike, and outflows continued on 11/24. Over the past 24 hours, the price fell while open interest rose; these data don’t tell me whether that’s bullish or bearish, so I won’t draw a conclusion. Daily closes are still holding above 1,538.00, which suggests there are buyers below. But until 1,711.08 is reclaimed and held, I’m treating this as a rebound in a weak market.

My view: I won’t call this a trend reversal just because the price rebounded about 20% from 1,538 or spiked to 1,845.07 intraday. Next, I’m watching three things: daily closes reclaiming 1,711.08—not just briefly passing it intraday or closing above it for only one day; this week’s candle closing above 1,724.34 at 08:00 on 11/30 (Monday), rather than forming an eighth consecutive down week; and clear, sustained net inflows into U.S. spot ETH ETFs, with ETHA no longer the main source of outflows. To call it a stronger trend, ETH would also need to reclaim 2,000, or even 2,127.46 (the close for the week of 11/2). Until these conditions are met, I see this as a bounce after a sharp wick down, not a reversal. If it breaks below 1,538.00 again, I’ll look for the next support level below rather than rushing to call it a bottom.

这代表什么？（以下是我的推论）
价格从 1,538 反弹到 1,845.07，盘中也站上过 1,835.35，但这更像是跟着 11/23 晚上风险偏好被拉起来的回升，不是新的配置盘进来。ETF 在冲高当天仍然净流出，11/24 又继续流出；最近 24 小时价格回落、持仓量却增加，这组数据看不出是多是空，我不下结论。1,538.00 日线收盘还在，说明下方有人接；但 1,711.08 没有站住之前，我只把它当成弱市里的反弹。

我的判断：我不会因为从 1,538 反弹了约 20%，或因为盘中冲到 1,845.07，就说已经转强。接下来我看三件事：日线收盘重新站回 1,711.08，而不是只在盘中路过、或只收回一天；本周周线在 11/30（周一）08:00 收在 1,724.34 上方，不要收出第八根周阴线；美国现货 ETH ETF 连续出现明确净流入，而且 ETHA 不再是流出主力。若要说转强，还要重新站回 2,000，甚至 2,127.46（11/2 那周收盘）。这些都没出现之前，我的看法是插针后的回拉，不是反转。如果再破 1,538.00，我会再重新找下方位置，而不是急着当成底部。

以太坊市场深度分析：持续承压下方关键支撑面临考验

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间2026年11月25日下午六点，以太坊现货报价1646美元，过去24小时内下跌约2.3%。从小时线来看，ETH在过去五个交易小时内呈现窄幅震荡偏弱的走势。价格从1660美元开盘，最低下探至1633美元，随后小幅反弹至1656美元后再度回落，最终在1648美元附近窄幅整理。整体来看，价格运行在布林带中轨1664美元下方，逼近下轨1637美元，短期走势明显偏弱。

以太坊近期面临多重压力。现货以太坊ETF持续遭遇赎回，近期单日净流出6410万美元，机构资金持续撤离。与此同时，一头鲸鱼通过OTC渠道向交易所存入了37929枚ETH，引发了局部现货市场的集中抛售。从基本面来看，以太坊基金会近期警告称，向抗量子密码学的迁移难度将超过2022年的合并升级，且由于AI加速了漏洞发现速度，可用时间更加紧迫。这一消息虽然长期来看有利于网络安全，但短期内增加了市场对技术路线不确定性的担忧。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，7周期均线1650美元已低于25周期均线1670美元和99周期均线1696美元，呈现标准的空头排列。指数移动平均线同样如此，EMA7为1651美元，EMA25为1668美元，EMA99为1697美元，短中长期均线层层下压，价格反弹受到明显阻力。超级趋势指标显示阻力位在1692美元，远高于当前价格，进一步确认了空头趋势。

MACD指标方面，DIF线为负12.93，DEA线为负12.43，柱状图为负0.50。虽然三线均处于零轴下方，但柱状图的绝对值正在缩小，表明空头动能有边际减弱的迹象。RSI指标显示，RSI6为39.22，RSI12为38.23，RSI24为40.70，均处于中性偏弱区间，既未超卖也未出现明显的底部背离信号。

translatedData.subTitle:
The script is almost the same in every market cycle:
① Doubt: Prices rise for a few days, but no one believes it; everyone is shouting, “It’s just a rebound—sell into it.”
② Acceptance: The market hits a new high, analysts start turning bullish, and retail investors tentatively jump in.
③ Excitement: Prices keep surging, people in the group start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is soaring.
⑤ Denial: Prices start falling, and everyone says, “It’s a healthy pullback—a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic: Prices plunge repeatedly, and everyone is cutting their losses—but the seeds of the next cycle are planted right here.

ETH fell to 1645.91, down 1.91% over 24 hours, but the perpetual funding rate bounced from +0.0010% to +0.0051%/8h. Prices are falling, yet the long premium has quintupled—this isn’t sentiment recovering; leveraged dip buyers are starting to pay the shorts.

Let’s break down that fee first. +0.0051% is settled every 8 hours, three times a day, which works out to about 5.6% annualized. The number alone isn’t outrageous. What matters is where it appeared: the rate had previously been drained to +0.0010%, meaning nobody was willing to pay for the prospect of prices rising. Now the price has fallen another 2%, but the rate has returned to five times that level. When price direction and willingness to pay diverge, it usually means the side that just entered is bearing the cost. Shorts don’t need to close; they’re actually collecting money.

The second data point is even more straightforward: long accounts make up 68.6%, with open interest at 3.945 billion USDT. The long/short account ratio reflects retail bias. 68.6% tells us there are more people on one side, not that there’s more money there; prices are driven by marginal selling pressure, not headcount. More importantly, open interest hasn’t contracted noticeably during the decline. Leverage hasn’t been flushed out; the positions have simply changed hands. In this kind of structure, even if prices merely move sideways, longs have to bear both the cost of holding their positions and unrealized losses. An annualized rate of 5.6% in a sideways market is a pure expense, not a free option to “hold and wait for a rally.”

As for trading volume: 6,822.5M USDT over 24 hours. That’s not thin, so the funding-rate signal isn’t noise in an illiquid market—it reflects real money changing hands.

The third dimension is sentiment. The most popular posts on the platform keep repeating two themes: “This is the bottom—copy trades automatically to buy the dip” and “Futures trading is harmful.” Add to that the broader backdrop: BTC stabilizing near 60,300, liquidations tripling, and ETF outflows hitting a November record. When this kind of content clusters, it often points to crowded longs, not capitulation. The true signs of a bottom are precisely the opposite: the share of long accounts falls, funding turns negative, and longs are no longer willing to pay. Right now, all of those signals point the other way: the account ratio is 68.6%, the premium is widening, and longs are paying more.

So I see two short-term scenarios. First, prices continue to drift down or move sideways, while the rate stays positive. Dip buyers around 1640–1650 get slowly ground down by costs, and the first wave of stop-losses accelerates the decline. Second, shorts get squeezed first before the market picks a direction. But positive funding suggests there isn’t enough fuel for an upside squeeze—shorts aren’t being penalized with fees; they’re collecting them, so they have no pressure to close. Neither scenario favors chasing longs here.

My approach: I won’t try to catch a falling knife. I’ll wait for one of two signals: funding falls below 0.002%, showing that leveraged enthusiasm is fading; or price reclaims the previous range on strong volume, showing real buying rather than leveraged buying. The bet right now is essentially that “longs are willing to keep paying 5.6% annualized.” That’s their wager, not mine. If you do participate, position size and leverage matter far more than getting the direction right.

At the end of the day, the most expensive part of buying the dip isn’t the price—it’s the time. Losing money is always faster than making it back.

ETH 跌到 1645.91，24 小时 -1.91%，但永续费率从 +0.0010% 弹回 +0.0051%/8h。价格在跌，多头溢价却翻了五倍——这不是情绪回暖，是杠杆抄底盘开始替空头付钱。

先把这笔费用摊开算。+0.0051% 每 8 小时结算一次，一天三次，折年化约 5.6%。单看数字不算夸张，关键是它出现的位置：费率此前被抽干到 +0.0010%，说明没人愿意为“会涨”这件事付费；现在价格又往下走 2%，费率却回到五倍水平。价格方向和付费意愿背离，通常意味着刚进场的那一方在承担成本。空头不需要回补，反而在收钱。

第二个数据更直白：多头账户占比 68.6%，持仓量 39.45 亿 USDT。多空账户比是散户偏向的指标，68.6% 只说明人多，不说明钱多；价格由边际卖压决定，不由人头数决定。更值得注意的是，持仓量在下跌过程中没有明显收缩，杠杆没被清洗掉，只是把持仓换了一批人。这种结构里，价格哪怕只是横盘，多头也要同时承担持仓成本和浮亏，5.6% 的年化在横盘市里是纯支出，不是“拿着等涨”的免费期权。

成交量这一块：24 小时 6822.5M USDT。这个量不算清淡，所以费率信号不是薄盘子里的噪音，是真金白银在换手。

第三个维度看情绪。广场上高热的内容翻来覆去是“这里就是底部，跟单自动抄底”和“合约害人”这两类；再叠加上 BTC 在 60,300 附近企稳、清算量翻三倍、ETF 流出创 11 月纪录的宏观背景。这种内容集中出现时，往往对应多头拥挤，而不是出清。真正的底部特征恰恰相反：多头账户占比往下掉、费率转负、多头不愿意再付钱。现在这些全反着来：账户比 68.6%，溢价扩张，多头在加价。

所以短线我给两个情景。一是继续阴跌或横盘，费率维持正溢价，1640–1650 这一带的抄底盘被一路磨成本，第一批止损会加速下行。二是先挤一波空头再选方向，但正费率说明向上挤的燃料不足——空头非但没被收费惩罚，还在收钱，没有必须平仓的压力。两种情景都不利于现在追多。

我的做法是：不做左侧接刀。等两个信号之一——费率回落到 0.002% 以下，说明杠杆热情退潮；或者价格放量站回前期平台，说明是真买盘而不是杠杆买盘。现在押注的本质是“多头愿意持续付 5.6% 年化”，那是他们的赌注，不是我的。真要参与，仓位和杠杆的重要性远高于方向判断。

说到底，抄底最贵的不是价格，是时间。亏钱总比回本快。

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of 6:00 p.m. Beijing time on November 25, 2026, Ethereum was trading at $1,646, down approximately 2.3% over the past 24 hours. On the hourly chart, ETH has traded in a narrow, slightly bearish range over the past five trading hours. The price opened at $1,660, fell to a low of $1,633, then rebounded slightly to $1,656 before falling again, and finally settled into a narrow range around $1,648. Overall, the price is trading below the Bollinger Bands middle band at $1,664 and approaching the lower band at $1,637, indicating clear short-term weakness.

Ethereum has recently faced multiple headwinds. Spot Ethereum ETFs continue to see redemptions, with recent daily net outflows of $64.1 million as institutional capital continues to withdraw. Meanwhile, a whale deposited 37,929 ETH into an exchange through OTC channels, triggering concentrated selling in the spot market. On the fundamental side, the Ethereum Foundation recently warned that migrating to post-quantum cryptography will be more challenging than the 2022 Merge upgrade. Moreover, AI is accelerating vulnerability discovery, making the available time frame more pressing. While this news may benefit network security in the long run, in the short term it has heightened concerns about uncertainty surrounding the technical roadmap.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Does It Mean for a Blockchain to Have “Fuel Costs”?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay gas fees to transfer tokens and to mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring tokens, trading, running
a contract) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who execute those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of gas).

【Why it’s related to token prices】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

Let's talk about nodes and validators.
Light clients download only block headers. When they need data for a particular transaction, they request the data and a Merkle proof from a full node.
One easily overlooked point: client diversity is very important. If the vast majority of nodes use the same client, a vulnerability in that client could affect the entire network.
Before running a validator node yourself, consider your hardware, bandwidth, and ability to maintain it. Frequent downtime will cost you rewards.
On Ethereum, running a validator requires staking at least 32 $ETH .

#ETH

轻节点只下载区块头，需要某笔交易的数据时再向全节点请求数据和默克尔证明。

自己运行验证者节点前想清楚硬件、带宽和维护能力，频繁掉线会损失奖励。

What is blind signing, and why shouldn’t you sign if you can’t understand what you’re signing?
Blind signing means confirming a signature even though you can only see a string of hashes or hexadecimal data and can’t understand its actual contents.
Blind signing effectively leaves the entire verification step to the website initiating the request. If something is wrong with the website, you have no way of noticing when you confirm.

啥叫盲签？为什么看不懂就别签？
盲签是指在只能看到一串哈希或十六进制数据、看不懂具体内容的情况下照样确认签名。
盲签相当于把核对这一步全部交给了发起请求的网站，网站一旦有问题，确认时根本无从察觉。

title: 扫货 BTC 的那家机构，把币提走了
subTitle:
四天前买入一万枚 $BTC 的 Abraxas Capital，这几天做了两件事。

第一件是把币从交易所提走。据链上分析师余烬监测（PANews 11 月 24 日报道），在反弹过程中，它又从 Kraken 提出了 2223 枚 BTC，价值约 1.41 亿美元。最近三天，它从各交易所累计提出 19820 枚，约 11.82 亿美元，对应均价 59665 美元。

第二件是平掉了一家链上衍生品平台上的全部头寸，并撤出剩余资金（PANews 11 月 25 日援引 MLM 的监测）。它在那家平台交易了将近两年，累计成交 134 亿美元，赚了约 5.3 亿美元，其中至少 6700 万来自资金费。这些头寸是它一只市场中性套利基金的一条腿。

两件事要分开看。提币是把资产转到自己的链上钱包，币离开了交易所，通常意味着短期内要在交易所卖出的部分变少了。平掉套利头寸，则是一条策略线的结束，和它手里的 BTC 卖不卖没有直接关系。

还有一条数字值得记下来，就是那条均价线：59665 美元。机构在大约这个价位把币提走，说明这个区域有资金认可的价值。但它不是承诺，机构的成本也会变。

接下来可以盯它提走的币有没有再动。链上地址是公开的，如果币重新转回交易所，才更可能是准备卖出。

（信息来自 PANews 11 月 24 日、25 日报道，不构成投资建议）

📊 Will October Core PCE Shift Fed Expectations? Bitcoin and Global Markets Face a Critical Test

By ATR CRYPTO DESK

All eyes are turning toward the latest US inflation data as investors assess whether the Federal Reserve will maintain its restrictive monetary policy or move toward further tightening.

October’s Core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index is an important indicator because it helps policymakers understand underlying inflation trends without the short term volatility of food and energy prices.

The outcome could influence the US dollar, stock market sentiment and cryptocurrency prices, making it an important event for traders worldwide.

🏦 Why Is Core PCE So Important?

Core PCE is the Federal Reserve’s preferred measure of underlying inflation.

The latest available official September figures showed:

• Monthly Core PCE: +0.3%

• Annual Core PCE: +3.1%

Both readings indicate that inflation remains above the Fed’s long term 2% target.

For October, the Cleveland Federal Reserve’s November 24 nowcast estimated monthly Core PCE at approximately 0.27% and annual inflation at 3.21%.

These are estimates, not official October results.

📈 What Are Markets Expecting?

Market participants are closely watching whether inflation will continue moving higher or begin showing signs of moderation.

Three possible outcomes could influence expectations:

1. Lower Than Expected Inflation

A softer reading could ease concerns about persistent inflation and potentially improve investor sentiment.

2. Higher Than Expected Inflation

A stronger reading could reinforce expectations for tighter monetary policy and put pressure on risk sensitive assets.

3. In Line With Expectations

If inflation matches forecasts, investors may focus more heavily on other economic indicators and Federal Reserve commentary.

₿ What Could Happen to Bitcoin?

Bitcoin remains sensitive to changes in global liquidity and monetary policy expectations.

A softer inflation reading could improve risk appetite and potentially support a recovery in $BTC.

However, a hotter than expected report could strengthen the US dollar and increase pressure on cryptocurrency markets.

Traders should also monitor trading volume, derivatives positioning and liquidation levels before drawing conclusions about the next Bitcoin move.

📉 Impact on Ethereum and Altcoins

Ethereum could also react to changes in market sentiment.

If investors become more comfortable taking risks, $ETH and other major altcoins could attract renewed buying interest.

On the other hand, tighter financial conditions could encourage investors to reduce exposure to higher risk assets.

This makes the inflation report relevant to the wider digital asset market, not just Bitcoin.

💵 The US Dollar and Federal Reserve Outlook

The US Dollar Index ($DXY) is another important market indicator to watch.

Stronger inflation could support expectations for tighter monetary policy, potentially benefiting the dollar.

A softer inflation reading could have the opposite effect, depending on how investors interpret the wider economic picture.

Markets are also paying attention to the Federal Reserve’s December policy meeting, with interest rate expectations already reflecting significant concern about inflation.

🔍 Three Key Factors Traders Should Monitor

1. Actual Inflation vs Forecasts

The difference between the reported figure and market expectations could determine the initial reaction.

2. Federal Reserve Expectations

Watch whether investors adjust their expectations for future interest rate decisions.

3. Bitcoin Market Structure

Monitor important support and resistance levels in $BTC rather than reacting emotionally to the first market move.

🎯 Final Thoughts

October’s Core PCE report is an important test for global financial markets.

Inflation remains above the Federal Reserve’s target, and policymakers need convincing evidence that price pressures are moving in the right direction.

For cryptocurrency investors, the connection between inflation, interest rates and liquidity remains particularly important.

The next move in $BTC and $ETH could depend on how investors interpret the latest inflation signals and what they mean for future Federal Reserve policy.

What is your expectation?

Will softer inflation give Bitcoin another opportunity to recover, or could persistent price pressure create more downside for the crypto market?

Betting on Keccak-256, the Ethereum Foundation didn’t choose the “faster” option this time.

Ethereum Foundation researchers have settled on a unified hash algorithm for the post-quantum upgrade, choosing Keccak-256 over BLAKE3, which generates proofs faster. The key consideration is Keccak-256’s longer history of cryptanalysis and deep integration into Ethereum’s existing architecture: addresses, signatures, and numerous protocols rely on it, making migration costs and compatibility risks minimal. The research team acknowledged that BLAKE3 is faster at generating proofs, but said its security record has not been tested in the field for as long.

This is a key point of convergence in Ethereum’s response to the quantum threat. It strengthens the long-term narrative of upgradability and resilience, not tomorrow’s market outlook. The risk is that the post-quantum migration as a whole will still take years. Settling on an approach is only the starting point; the harder challenges lie in the signature scheme and the pace of on-chain implementation.

Scenario 1: If work on selecting a signature scheme progresses smoothly, ecosystem consistency will be the main thing to watch. Scenario 2: If the testnet timeline remains unclear, the market will most likely continue to ignore this development. Which would you rather see first: the signature scheme finalized or the testnet timeline?

ETH is down 66% from its ATH. Does it look cheap enough to rush in? Not so fast. My signal: wait and see, with a bullish bias, but it’s not time to chase yet.

Only a break above 1755.8 would truly turn the outlook bullish. Trading volume is more than 5% of market cap, suggesting a major move is approaching, but higher volume only signals disagreement and turnover; it doesn’t guarantee an upward move.

On sentiment, the Fear & Greed Index is 11, and the weekly average is also 11. Price is weak, and sentiment is even weaker, creating a positive divergence. Lido tightens Ethereum staking penalties as operators gain access to larger validators

Lido voters backed a proposal on Nov. 23 to let the committee overseeing its two community staking modules recover more Ethereum staking losses from operators’ bonds.

In the March slashing case that prompted the vote, Lido’s contracts automatically recovered about 43% of the loss, while the operator voluntarily covered the rest.

The Snapshot result posted on Lido’s governance forum showed 53.8 million $LDO in favor and 4.1 million against, enough to reach quorum. The off-chain vote backed a wider remit for the committee overseeing Lido’s two open-entry Community Staking Modules, 0x01 and 0x02.
The vote carried zero on-chain actions, so individual penalties must still be reported and settled separately.

The updated mandate extends an existing penalty mechanism used when operators divert block rewards. It would also cover staking rewards missed after slashing, along with incidents that could harm the protocol, such as withdrawal delays or risks to validator key security.

Committee members who backed the change called for documented evidence, credit for losses already recovered, and a chance for operators to respond.

Lido’s final incident report put the March 12 slashing at 0.7973122 eth in penalties and missed rewards. When the six validators withdrew, Lido’s contracts automatically took 0.3459189 eth from the operator’s bond to cover the withdrawal shortfall.

The operator voluntarily paid the remaining 0.4513933 eth after the committee made contact, and Lido reported that the incident was fully resolved in April.

In a similar case under the wider mandate, the committee could assess the missed rewards separately and lock collateral against that amount. The amount Lido could collect at settlement would depend on the bond left after the automatic deduction.

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay to each other. The exchange only collects and distributes the money; it doesn’t profit from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no settlement date, so how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

Can you accept that you misread the market?

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add more margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Losses eat through the maintenance margin requirement, and the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of the position first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

title: 十一点盯着1,698的以太坊，昨晚没被砸死，今天怎么反而不敢动了
subTitle:
快十一点了，泡了杯茶又切回日线图看了好几遍，手里握着单子反而有点下不去手。

说实话，昨晚这盘面搁谁看都得骂两句。美股那边因为关税加上火热的PCE数据直接崩了一波，纳指100跌超4.5%，连带着美光这些芯片股砸了快12%。大饼昨晚顺势跟着往下猛踹一脚，$BTC 最低干到 57,300.38，当时群里一片鬼哭狼嚎，好多做短线的兄弟估计连止损都来不及撤就被扫出去了。结果呢？半夜硬生生拉回来收在 60,458.01，今早冲到 61,622.38 没站稳，现在又晃悠回 60,733 附近，24小时成交额 16.1 亿美元，全网都在这六万关口来回扯皮。

但真正让我看得直皱眉的，还不是大饼，是 $ETH 。

把以太坊的日线图往左拉一拉真的挺扎心。九月下旬那会儿高点还在 2,807.34，一路阴跌下来，11月21号直接插到 1,538.00，23号勉强反弹摸到 1,845.07 又被按回原地。昨晚那波下杀，4小时级别直接砸出 2.069 亿美元的放量插针，最低踩到 1,608.86，今早跟着冲到 1,730.00，结果到了十一点又卡回 1,698.26，24小时成交额 6.92 亿美元。

就差两块钱站上一千七，偏偏磨了一上午就是不给痛快。你看日线均线就明白了，现在价格勉强贴着 7 日线 1,687.82 喘口气，可头顶上 25 日线还挂在 1,943.63，99 日线更是在 2,359.61 远得没边，上方套牢盘跟厚棉被一样压着，每次冲过千七就有人急着解套出货。

更魔幻的是今天刷到的大资金动向，简直像左右手互搏。一边是 Abraxas Capital 刚买了 4,230 枚以太坊，另一边场外鲸鱼反手就甩了 37,929 枚，连 ETF 发行商那边也传出净流出 6,400 万美元。大饼那边也一样拧巴，CFTC 刚认可衍生品交易所和清算所可以用比特币充当部分运营储备，裕信银行也推了本金保护型比特币挂钩产品，可看图派还在盯着 58,000 反复测试的风险喊小心。

利好有人拿来说事，砸盘也有人真金白银地出，难怪行情走得跟喝醉了一样，跌到 1,608 砸不动，弹到 1,730 又没人敢接力。

昨晚我本来挂了低位空单想顺势吃一口，早上一看下影线拉这么长直接撤了；刚才看它卡在 1,698 想追个多，瞄了眼上方均线压力又把手缩了回来。刚经历过 11 月 21 号到 25 号这种上下几千刀大洗盘，两边打脸才是最难受的。我在 1,680 到 1,730 这几十块钱空间里暂时先当看客，等它带量站稳 1,730 或重新回踩确认 1,608 再说，瞎动纯属送手续费。

行情磨人时稳住心态，以上纯属个人盯盘碎碎念，不构成投资建议，真动手前自己掂量好仓位和止损。

#ETH #BTC #加密市场

translatedData.title: Watching Ethereum at 1,698 at eleven: it survived last night’s dump, so why am I suddenly afraid to make a move today?
translatedData.subTitle:
It’s almost eleven. I made a cup of tea, switched back to the daily chart, and checked it over and over. With a position on, I’m finding it hard to pull the trigger.

Honestly, anyone looking at last night’s market would’ve had a few choice words. U.S. stocks took a nosedive on tariffs and scorching-hot PCE data: the Nasdaq 100 fell more than 4.5%, dragging chip stocks like Micron down nearly 12%. Bitcoin followed suit and took a sharp dive last night, $BTC  hitting a low of 57,300.38. The group chat was in total panic—plenty of short-term traders probably got stopped out before they even had a chance to cancel their stop-losses. And then? It clawed its way back overnight to close at 60,458.01. This morning it rallied to 61,622.38 but couldn’t hold, and now it’s hovering around 60,733 again. 24-hour trading volume is $1.61 billion, and the whole market is tussling back and forth around that 60,000 level.

translatedData.content:
You’ve barely made a profit and you’re already scared, calling it quits? The market hasn’t even flinched.
Tariffs hit and Nasdaq futures dropped more than 3%,
while gold, silver, and Bitcoin all strengthened in sync.
$ETH  got dumped on by an ICO whale at 1,665, who offloaded 32,100 coins,
but with nearly 9.4 billion U in trading volume, it still bounced back to 1,700, up 2.68%.

Both safe-haven assets and buyers are still in the market—money hasn’t gone anywhere.
A market that’s really about to collapse doesn’t bounce back with a bullish candle on heavy volume.
I’m staying long and holding ETH; if it loses 1,665, I’ll admit defeat.
Are you cashing out and handing over your coins because of tariffs, or are you brave enough to go long at 1,700 and bet on more upside?

#ETH

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；

但把周期拉长，画面完全不同。$BTC 30日跌幅 -25.2%，30日区间 58,951.51–81,343.50，现价 60,871.28 距离区间下沿只有约 3% 的空间。换句话说，今天这根阳线放在月度坐标里，只是从底部往上挪了一小步，7日 +3.3% 也印证了这一点——修复是有的，但力度还谈不上反转。

更值得盯的是情绪面。恐贪指数读数 11，落在 Extreme Fear 区间。价格在反弹，情绪却压在极值附近，这种背离通常意味着两件事：一是前期下跌的筹码还没消化完，二是增量资金入场意愿依然偏谨慎。反弹由空头回补驱动的可能性，高于由新多头建仓驱动。

消息面上，Cointelegraph 的每日综述继续跟踪影响 BTC 价格、DeFi、Web3 与加密监管的动向，宏观与监管变量仍是当前定价的主要扰动源，而非链上基本面。

结构上我会这样拆：短期看 7日 +3.3% 能否延续，中期看现价能否守住 30日区间下沿 58,951.51 一线。守住，则今天的反弹具备筑底讨论的价值；失守，则 +2.69% 只是下跌中继的一次喘息。恐惧极值本身不是买入理由，但它说明悲观预期已经被定价得比较充分，后续任何边际改善都容易被放大。

今天真正的问题不在涨幅，而在情绪与价格的裂口何时收敛。你更关注哪个信号先动——是恐贪指数先爬出 Extreme Fear，还是 BTC 先站稳 30日区间下沿？

title: Altcoins Are Bleeding, But Is Smart Money Accumulating?
subTitle:
The cryptocurrency market is going through a difficult phase. Bitcoin has faced significant selling pressure, altcoins are struggling, and investor confidence remains weak.
But beneath the market weakness, an important question deserves attention:
Are smart money investors quietly accumulating quality altcoins, or is capital still leaving the market?
Let's look beyond the price charts and examine what the latest market data tells us.
1. Liquidity Is Becoming a Major Concern
One of the biggest challenges for the crypto market right now is declining liquidity.
According to Binance Research's November 23 weekly market commentary:

Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $1.79 billion in net outflows during the week.
Total outflows over three consecutive weeks reached approximately $4.1 billion.
Stablecoin supply declined by $13.9 billion over three weeks, reaching approximately $282.5 billion.

These numbers suggest that investors are reducing exposure rather than aggressively increasing risk.
This is an important warning sign for altcoin investors because smaller crypto assets are particularly sensitive to liquidity conditions.
2. Are Smart Money Investors Buying the Dip?
This is where things become interesting.
A falling market does not necessarily mean every major investor is selling. Some investors may be accumulating selected assets while others are reducing exposure.
However, available smart-money tracking data does not yet confirm broad accumulation.
A November 25 market snapshot showed tracked smart-money wallets had a net reduction of approximately $88,000 over 24 hours.
Interestingly, some wallets added exposure to PUMP, but its broader 30-day flow remained negative.
This highlights an important point:
Selective buying is not the same as market-wide accumulation.
3. What Do On-Chain Indicators Tell Us?
Investors should monitor several important indicators before making decisions.
Stablecoin Supply: Growing stablecoin liquidity can indicate increasing potential buying power.
TVL Growth: Rising Total Value Locked can indicate stronger capital participation in a protocol.
Exchange Outflows: Persistent outflows may reduce immediate selling pressure, but do not automatically prove accumulation.

Wallet Activity: Consistent buying by established investors can provide useful clues.
Trading Volume: Increasing volume alongside price stabilization may indicate renewed interest.

No single indicator can confirm a market reversal. Multiple signals should support the same conclusion.
4. Where Could Opportunities Emerge?
Instead of chasing every falling altcoin, investors should focus on projects with:

Strong fundamentals and real utility.
Growing ecosystem activity.
Sustainable tokenomics.
Healthy liquidity conditions.
Consistent development and user adoption.

Projects with genuine demand may recover more sustainably than tokens driven mainly by speculation.
5. My Final Thoughts
I believe the current market requires patience rather than aggressive buying.
Bitcoin ETF outflows, declining stablecoin supply, and cautious smart-money positioning suggest that the market has not yet provided convincing evidence of a broad accumulation phase.
However, this does not mean every altcoin is a bad investment.
The next opportunity may come from identifying fundamentally strong projects before market sentiment improves.
Don't confuse falling prices with smart money accumulation. Follow the capital, study the fundamentals, and wait for confirmation.
What is your strategy right now?
Are you accumulating quality altcoins, holding stablecoins, or waiting for a stronger market reversal?

U.S. October PCE Monthly Rate Falls to 0.3%; Core Inflation Hits Nearly Three-Year High

On the evening of November 25 Beijing time, the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis released its October PCE price index report. The PCE is the inflation measure most closely watched by the Federal Reserve. Released several weeks before the mid-December policy meeting, the data are seen as a key reference point for assessing the policy path. The Fed held rates steady in October to get a clearer picture of price trends, but the minutes of that meeting had already hinted at a bias toward rate hikes, leaving markets eager to determine the true direction of inflation.

First, the key facts. The monthly rate of the October PCE price index was 0.3%, down significantly from 0.5% the previous month and in line with market expectations. The annual rate was 3.8%, up from 3.7% in September and at its highest level since May, also in line with expectations. Excluding volatile food and energy prices, the monthly rate of the October core PCE price index was 0.3%, unchanged from the previous month. The annual core PCE rate was 3.3%, above the market expectation of 3.2% and the highest since November 2023. Looking at the longer-term trend, the monthly core PCE rate rose from 0.1% in June to 0.2% in July and August, then remained at 0.3% for two consecutive months in September and October—a clear sign of persistent month-by-month pressure.

The dynamics behind the data are worth unpacking. The monthly rate fell while the annual rate rose, indicating that inflationary pressure has not eased on a year-over-year basis; the stronger-than-expected rise in the core measure further confirms price stickiness. U.S. inflation has remained above the Fed’s 2% target for more than six consecutive years, continually eroding consumers’ purchasing power. Fed officials broadly believe inflation risks remain elevated, citing resilient demand and still-loose financial conditions. Deutsche Bank economists say the Fed’s policy communications continue to lean hawkish, with the debate shifting from whether further rate hikes are needed to the pace, size, and overall extent of any further tightening. Wall Street investment banks almost unanimously expect the Fed to raise rates at its mid-December meeting and again early next year.

For crypto markets, the main transmission channel is dollar liquidity. A stronger-than-expected rise in core inflation could reinforce rate-hike expectations, pushing up the dollar and interest rates and tightening valuation conditions for global risk assets. Crypto assets are particularly sensitive to changes in liquidity. However, the report showed a decline in the overall monthly rate, and most indicators met expectations, so the short-term impact may not be severe. The real variable is the final decision at the December meeting. It is also important to distinguish the data itself from expectations already priced in by markets: when rate-hike expectations are widely shared, prices may move counterintuitively even after the data are released. This is common when markets price macroeconomic events.

Editor’s note: Facts and speculation should be clearly distinguished. The verified facts are that the annual core inflation rate reached its highest level since November 2023, the monthly rate remained at 0.3% for two consecutive months, and markets broadly expect a rate hike in December. The speculation that follows is this: if tightening proceeds as expected, liquidity conditions are unlikely to be favorable for crypto markets; if subsequent data show inflation cooling, a revision in expectations could instead create an opportunity for risk-asset prices to recover. The mid-December policy meeting and the next round of inflation data are the two key developments to watch in the near term.

content:
美国10月PCE月率回落至0.3% 核心通胀创近三年新高

北京时间11月25日晚间，美国经济分析局公布10月PCE物价指数报告。PCE是美联储最看重的通胀衡量指标，这份数据发布于12月中旬议息会议数周之前，被视为判断政策路径的关键参考。美联储10月按兵不动，以便更清晰地观察物价趋势，但10月会议纪要已流露出加息倾向，市场急需判断通胀的真实方向。

先看核心事实。10月PCE物价指数月率为0.3%，较上月的0.5%显著回落，符合市场预期；10月PCE物价指数年率为3.8%，高于9月的3.7%，创5月以来高位，同样符合预期。剔除波动较大的食品和能源后，10月核心PCE物价指数月率为0.3%，与上月持平；核心PCE年率为3.3%，高于市场预期的3.2%，创2023年11月以来最高水平。拉长序列看，核心PCE月率自6月的0.1%起步，7月与8月录得0.2%，9月与10月连续两个月维持在0.3%，逐月抬升的粘性迹象清晰可见。

数据背后的逻辑值得拆解。整体月率回落而年率走高，说明同比维度的通胀压力并未缓解；核心指标超预期抬升，进一步印证价格粘性。美国通胀率已连续六年以上高于美联储2%的目标，居民实际购买力持续被侵蚀。美联储官员普遍认为，通胀风险仍处于较高水平，原因包括需求保持韧性、金融环境依然宽松。德意志银行经济学家表示，美联储的政策沟通持续呈现鹰派倾向，讨论焦点正从是否需要进一步加息，转向后续紧缩的节奏、幅度和总规模。华尔街投行几乎一致预计，美联储将在12月中旬会议上加息，并于明年初再次加息。

对加密市场而言，传导路径主要经由美元流动性。核心通胀超预期上行会强化加息预期，推升美元与利率水平，收紧全球风险资产的估值环境，而加密资产对流动性变化尤为敏感。不过这份报告整体月率回落、多数指标符合预期，短线冲击未必剧烈，真正的变量在于12月会议的最终决断。还需区分数据本身与市场已消化的预期：当加息预期高度一致时，即便数据落地，价格也可能出现与直觉相反的波动，这是宏观事件定价中的常见现象。

编辑观察：需要明确区分事实与推测。已核实的事实是核心通胀年率创2023年11月以来新高、月率连续两个月维持0.3%、市场普遍预期12月加息。由此展开的推测是：若紧缩如期推进，流动性环境对加密市场难言宽松；若后续数据显示通胀降温，预期修正反而可能成为风险资产价格修复的契机。12月中旬的议息会议与下一轮通胀数据，是近期最值得跟踪的两个节点。

BTC 从 57300 的低点一路抬到 61622，现在停在 60646，涨幅 1.94%。ETH +1.9% 报 1699，XRP 最猛 +2.33% 到 0.9419，BNB +1.87% 到 555.72。开盘一片红，评论区已经开始排练“牛回速归”。
泼冷水的来了。
① 看高点。BTC 24 小时最高 61622，贴着日线 R1 61583 摸了一下就被打回来。摸一下轴点就缩回去的，多半是假动作。61583 没站稳之前，“反转”两个字先咽回肚子里。
② 看量能。涨了 2%，BTC 24 小时成交额 16.5 亿美元。就这点量想掀翻 61583 的桌子，够呛。没有量配合的突破，纸糊的。
③ 看位置。好消息：BTC 站在日线 PP 59442 上方，离 S1 58316 还有一段安全距离，日内回调暂时都算良性洗盘。ETH 一个模子：1699 坐在 PP 1666 之上，R1 1724 顶着脑门，24 小时高点 1730 同样是摸完就缩。
方向：偏多。这是数据给的答案——四大币种全线收红、全部站在轴点上方，空头暂时拿不出像样的反击。但偏多不等于闭眼追高，剧本就两条：
BTC 放量站稳 61583，日内卖点变支撑，行情升级；站不稳，就在 59442 到 61583 之间来回磨，磨到没脾气。跌破 59442 下看 58316，那里失守，才是下行风险加大的开始。
ETH 照抄作业：1724 过不去就回踩 1666，1634 是底线。XRP 玩得最野，0.9419 已经贴着 R1 0.96 的脸，冲过去是英雄，冲不过去 0.9 再见。
涨 2% 不叫行情，站稳轴点才叫。追高党的学费，年年都有人续费。

📰 Why is BlackRock launching a tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong? What does $100M in assets mean?

BlackRock has launched a digital money market fund in Hong Kong called the HKD Digital Liquidity Fund, open to retail and institutional investors, with an initial size of $100 million. This is the first time a major asset manager has launched this kind of product in Hong Kong, bringing the traditional fund model directly into the crypto space.

Why does this news matter?
BlackRock’s move is essentially a landmark event in the shift toward public-fund structures in the crypto market. The traditional fund model means more standardized investment thresholds, more transparent fund management, and broader investor access. This is not the first similar product—Fidelity, BlackRock, and others have previously launched ETFs, but fund structures offer an investment experience more akin to equity funds. As a global asset management giant, BlackRock’s entry will greatly enhance market standardization. Especially in Hong Kong, where financial regulation is relatively mature, it could become a trendsetter for other asset managers.

Impact on the market
The direct impact on BTC and ETH may be felt more in market sentiment. On the one hand, the entry of major asset managers could attract some traditional capital to the crypto market. But given that these products are more likely to track indexes than actively take long positions, their direct price impact may be limited. On the other hand, these products may divert some capital from spot trading, but they are essentially a complement to asset allocation, not a substitute. As a historical reference, after Fidelity launched a Bitcoin fund in 2018, the crypto market did not see a sustained rally. This suggests that these products have more of a structural than a trend-driven impact on prices.

💡 The emergence of these products means the crypto market is becoming more integrated with the traditional financial system, but in the short term, it will not change the volatility of BTC and ETH, which is driven by speculative capital. If more asset managers launch similar products in the future and they continue to attract inflows, they could gradually alter the market’s supply-and-demand structure—but that process may take years.

If a major cryptocurrency hack occurs or global regulations tighten, the expansion of these products may stall, invalidating the current assessment.

📰 为何BlackRock要在香港搞tokenized money market fund？$100M资金量意味着什么？

BlackRock在香港推出了一款名为HKD Digital Liquidity Fund的数字货币基金，面向零售和机构投资者开放，初始规模达$100 million。这是大资管首次在香港推出此类产品，直接将传统金融的基金模式搬到了加密货币领域。

为什么这条新闻重要？
BlackRock此举本质上是加密市场公募基金化的标志性事件。传统金融的基金模式意味着更规范的投资门槛、更透明的资金管理和更广泛的投资者覆盖。这并非首次出现类似产品——之前已有富达、贝莱德等推出ETF，但基金形式更接近股票型基金的投资体验。BlackRock作为全球资产管理巨头，其进入会极大提升市场规范化程度，尤其在香港这个金融监管相对成熟的市场，可能会成为其他资管机构的跟风标。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH的直接影响可能更多体现在情绪层面。一方面，大资管的入场会吸引部分传统资金关注加密市场，但考虑到这类产品的投资策略更可能是跟踪指数而非主动做多，对价格直接推动力度有限。另一方面，这类产品会分流部分现货交易资金，但本质是资产配置的补充而非替代。历史参考上，2018年Fidelity推出比特币基金后，加密市场并未出现持续上涨，说明这类产品对价格的影响更多是结构性的而非趋势性的。

💡 这类产品的出现意味着加密市场正在加速融入传统金融体系，但短期内不会改变BTC和ETH由投机资金主导的波动特性。如果未来出现更多资管机构推出类似产品，且这些产品持续获得资金流入，可能会逐步改变市场供需结构，但这个过程可能需要数年时间。

如果出现大型加密货币黑客攻击或全球性监管收紧，这类产品的规模扩张可能会停滞，现有判断作废。

从小时K线来看，最近五根K线呈现稳步攀升的格局。价格从一千六百八十四美元开盘，逐步上行至一千七百美元，成交量从一千四百五十九万枚以太坊放大到最新一根K线的两千万枚，成交额达到三千四百二十四万美元。量能配合价格上行，说明买盘力量正在增强。

均线系统方面，七日均线一千六百八十八美元已经上穿二十五日均线一千六百六十三美元，形成短期看多排列。价格目前运行在所有短中期均线之上，但仍然略低于九十九日均线一千六百九十五美元，这一位置构成短期的关键阻力。

MACD指标表现积极。MACD线从负值区域回升至五点四七，信号线也从负值修复至零点九九九附近，柱状图连续五根保持正值并稳定在六点四七左右。MACD柱状图由负转正并持续扩大，表明短期多头动能正在逐步积累。

RSI指标显示，六周期RSI达到七十九点九三，接近超买区域。十二周期RSI为六十六点二二，二十四周期RSI为五十六点零七。短期RSI偏高意味着价格可能面临技术性回调的需求。

布林带上轨位于一千七百零五美元，中轨在一千六百六十三美元，下轨在一千六百二十一美元。价格已经触及布林带上轨附近，短期内需要关注能否有效突破一千七百零五美元的阻力位。

KDJ指标中，K值为八十一点零九，D值为八十点二六，J值为八十二点七五。J值从九十九点四一回落至八十二点七五，显示短期上行动能有所衰减。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前的技术因子统计显示，十五个因子中有七个做多、八个做空，空方略占优势。综合指标发出明确的做空信号，历史胜率高达百分之七十七点七八，这一信号值得投资者重视。

title: 忘了提币，资产可能每月被扣 5%
subTitle:
项目关停之后，留在上面的资产不会原地等你。据 PANews 11 月 24 日报道，2026 年至今已有 100 个加密项目宣布关停，它们合计融资约 10 亿美元，生命周期内累计手续费只有约 2.5 亿美元。收入撑不起支出的项目，最后都会走到这一步。

关停通常伴随一个提现截止日。Sophon 的截止日是 11 月 25 日，CoinEx、Abstract、DJED 等项目的截止日集中在 12 月。过了截止日还没有提走的资产，可能会被按月扣费，报道里提到的比例是 5%。按这个比例，一年下来会被扣掉将近一半。

这种损失有一个共同点：它和行情无关，和操作水平也无关，只和你有没有盯着有关。很多人手里有几十个早年参与过的小额资产，白拿的、测试网的、活动奖励的，平时根本想不起来，等项目没了才想起来查。

对付它不需要什么技巧，需要的是一次盘点。把你在用的钱包和交易所账户列出来，逐个看一下余额里有哪些是不再活跃的项目的代币。看到关停公告就记下截止日，宁可早提，不要等到最后一周，关停前的最后几天往往是最拥堵的时候。提不出来或者不值得提的小额资产，当它已经归零，不要为它再投入时间。

行情好的时候没人关心这些。今年行情冷，关停的项目已经有一百个，这些被遗忘的余额是少数完全可以避免的损失。

（信息来自 PANews 11 月 24 日报道，不构成投资建议）

A whale from the 2014 IC0 has sold another 22,010 ETH. What is really worth unpacking here is not the 5,477-fold return, but the pace at which low-cost holdings are supplied to exchanges. My view is that the selling pressure from whales like this depends more on their willingness to dispose of their remaining holdings and how they sell than on whether the price has “bottomed.” This assumes that this sale was only part of its 100,000 ETH IC0 holdings.

According to PANews, citing monitoring by Onchain Lens on November 26, the address bought 100,000 ETH at $0.31 during the 2014 IC0, at a cost of about $31,000. It has now sold 22,010 ETH through Binance and Bybit, worth about $37.38 million at $1,698 per ETH, compared with an original IC0 value of about $6,823. The facts confirm only the purchase cost, the amount sold this time, and the venues used; the source material does not say how much the address currently has left or whether it will continue selling.

My observation is that a cost basis of $0.31 means there is virtually no “break-even selling pressure” in the traditional sense; the price level is unlikely to constrain its selling decisions. Choosing venues with concentrated liquidity, such as Binance and Bybit, also looks more like a staged sale based on the available market depth. From this, I infer that the market is facing not panic selling in the short term, but a controlled pace of supply driven by motives disconnected from the current price. This is only an inference, however: a single sale is not enough to prove ongoing distribution, nor can it be used to predict ETH’s direction.

The conditions that would invalidate this assessment are specific: if subsequent on-chain data shows the address moving its remaining holdings back to self-custody and leaving them untouched for a long time, the assessment of supply pressure should be downgraded; if large transfers to exchanges and staged sales continue, that would indicate that the sell-off is ongoing. Worth tracking are the address’s subsequent transfers, exchange inflows, and whether the price and market depth show any abnormal changes after this sale. title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#交易干货 #仓位 #风险教育 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading insights | The math behind going all-in—dare you after reading this?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% when right and losing 50% when wrong. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in each time, let’s calculate the long-term result: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
That looks like positive expected value. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean -75%, and you’d need a +300% gain just to break even.
Positive expected value + going all-in = a high chance of going broke. That’s the gambler’s ruin theorem playing out every day in crypto.
day after day.

With the same strategy, but risking only 20% of your position each time: two losses in a row mean -18%—hardly devastating,
while you still capture the strategy’s long-term expected gains. The strategy hasn’t changed; only your position size has, and that makes all the difference between survival and ruin.
