Zoom announces a dividend—but what is it signaling?

Zoom Communications beat earnings expectations and initiated a quarterly dividend, showing that its strategy of targeting large customers is paying off—a positive sign for tech stocks and investors holding related ETFs.

Zoom Communications has just released its earnings report, with revenue and profits both exceeding market expectations. The company unexpectedly announced an annual dividend of $0.25 per share, something it had never done before. The signal is clear: Zoom is preparing to distribute more of its profits to investors. At the same time, it has recently been aggressively pursuing large enterprise customers, suggesting that making money has become easier. For tech-focused funds like ARK 40 ETF, a show of confidence from a leading company like Zoom is a shot in the arm for the entire sector.

Market impact
- Short term: News like this could lift tech ETFs and indirectly support ETH and BTC, since many people view ETH as “digital gold” and see it as closely linked to tech stocks. Funds may flow out of riskier altcoins and back into these more established companies.
- Medium term: If large enterprise customers become the norm, valuations across the software industry could be reassessed. In the long run, this could benefit crypto projects that serve large customers. Regulators may pay more attention to companies with stable earnings rather than purely speculative projects.

My take
This is positive for both ETH and BTC, but the impact won’t be especially strong. ETH has recently been consolidating around $1,700. CFTC suddenly green-lights crypto as margin—can Bitcoin breathe a sigh of relief?

The U.S. CFTC is allowing Bitcoin, Ether, and stablecoins to be used as futures margin. Crypto companies will have more flexibility in how they use their funds, but regulators are still cautious.

We talked about this just a couple of days ago, and now there’s a new development. The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has formally approved crypto exchanges using Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins (such as USDC and USDT) to bolster their capital buffers. Put simply, crypto companies will be able to use these digital assets as collateral on exchanges, much like cash. For example, if Company A wants to borrow 10,000 bitcoins from Company B but only has 5,000, it can now make up the difference with USDT—effectively adding some financial leverage to the crypto market. The CFTC did clarify, however, that this is only a short-term liquidity measure; longer-term regulation is still in the works.

Impact on the market
- Short term: Sentiment around crypto could improve, as this is a positive signal from regulators that the government isn’t opposed to crypto becoming part of the existing financial system. Funds may flow back from other risk assets into mainstream assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum.
- Medium term: The industry landscape could shift. Smaller exchanges may find it harder to compete if they aren’t eligible to use these assets. The regulatory approach is “develop while regulating”—not a blanket ban.

My take
With Bitcoin and Ether at $61,614.91 and $1,721.61, respectively, this CFTC decision may provide them with short-term support, but the broader direction will still depend on the real economy and institutional capital. Don’t be too harsh if I’m wrong—I’m only testing the waters with a small position myself.

前两天刚说过这件事，现在有了新进展。美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）正式批准了加密货币交易所用比特币、以太坊和稳定币（比如USDC、USDT）来充实自己的资本缓冲。说白了，就是加密公司以后可以用这些数字资产当钱一样，在交易所里做抵押。比如A公司想借B公司1万个比特币，但手里只有5000个，现在可以用USDT补足，相当于给加密市场加了点金融杠杆。不过CFTC也说了，这只是短期流动性方案，长期监管还在路上。

对市场的影响
- 短期：加密货币情绪能暖和点，因为这是监管层面给的一个积极信号，说明官方不排斥加密货币融入现有金融体系。资金可能会从其他风险资产回流到比特币和以太坊这种主流资产上。
- 中期：行业格局可能要变，小交易所可能因为没资格用这些资产而更难竞争。监管趋势是“边发展边规范”，不会一刀切。

我的判断
比特币和以太在$61,614.91和$1,721.61这个位置，CFTC这个决定让它们短期有支撑，但大方向还是要看实体经济和机构资金。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位试试。

【Risk assets sell off again, but ETH holds up first】

After the stock market sell-off resumed, ETH and DeFi fell about twice as much as BTC. Yet ETH is still hovering around $1,690.39, up 0.8% over 24 hours. The Fear & Greed Index is just 13, with a weekly average of 11. Trading volume exceeds 5% of market cap, and tokens are changing hands rapidly. A major move may be near, but its direction is still unclear.

I’ve been through several cycles: ETH entered extreme fear territory at around $80 in 2018, $130 in 2020, and $88 in 2022. Each time, it later recovered severalfold. But this time, it’s still 66% below its high. You can call it cheap, but you can’t say its value has already been realized.

In practical terms, lower prices reduce the cost of experimentation for DeFi and L2 projects. Developers, security providers, and computing-power providers may benefit first. Whether the business case holds up depends on whether the ecosystem can keep generating fees and demand. The Foundation moving up its post-quantum deadline to 2028 is long-term catch-up work, not a short-term rescue.

On-chain signals so far don’t prove that large holders are quietly accumulating. It would take sustained accumulation or staking by large addresses, net outflows from exchanges, and prices no longer making new lows to count as genuine accumulation. If the pressure instead comes from leverage and borrowed-coin selling, a bounce could still be an opportunity to exit. My take: ETH may offer a conditional buying opportunity, but don’t catch a falling knife blindly. The conditions are that selling pressure eases and the price holds its lows after volume picks up. The risks include security incidents, liquidity shocks, and ecosystem demand failing to materialize.

Would you buy ETH during extreme fear? Go all in at once, or buy in batches and wait for confirmation?

title: 被套之后，先想清楚三个问题
subTitle:
价格跌下去之后，账户里那笔 $BTC 变成了浮亏。这时候人最容易做两件事：不停刷行情，或者在赌气和不甘心之间来回切换。比情绪更有用的是先把下面三个问题想清楚。

第一，当初买入的理由还成立吗。如果买的时候依据的是某个事件或某条消息，而它已经兑现或者落空，这笔交易原有的逻辑就没了，浮亏多少不应该影响判断。如果依据的是长期的配置计划，而计划的前提没有变，下跌就只是价格波动。

第二，这笔钱需要什么时候用。半年内要用的钱和五年内不动的钱，是完全不同的处理方式。前者不该承受这种波动，认错离场不丢人；后者可以按原计划继续，甚至利用低价完成后面几期的买入。

第三，现在的仓位睡得着吗。如果浮亏让你半夜醒来刷行情，说明仓位超过了你的承受能力，应该减到能睡着为止，这和看不看好没有关系。

三种情况对应三种做法：理由没了就退出，资金是长期的且逻辑还在就持有或按计划继续买，仓位过重就先减。最糟的是第四种，什么都不决定，名义上叫长期持有，其实只是不敢面对。

浮亏不是决策的依据，它只是已经发生的价格。决定怎么做，要看往前的东西：理由、期限和承受力。

（不构成投资建议）

translatedData.title: After You’re Stuck in a Losing Position, Think Through These Three Questions
translatedData.subTitle:
After the price fell, that $BTC  in your account became an unrealized loss. At this point, it’s easy to do one of two things: constantly check the market, or swing between frustration and regret. Instead of letting your emotions take over, it’s more useful to first think through these three questions.

First, are the reasons you bought still valid? If you bought based on an event or a piece of news, and it has already happened or failed to materialize, then the original rationale for the trade is gone. How much the position is down should not affect your judgment. If you bought as part of a long-term allocation plan and the assumptions behind that plan haven’t changed, then the decline is just price fluctuation.

Markets fell before rebounding yesterday: Bitcoin recovered after dipping below $60,000 intraday, and stood at $60,289 this morning, up 0.43% over 24 hours. Ethereum stood at $1,691, up 0.50%. However, ETF outflows are still setting records. Here are four stories to watch today:

1. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs post record November net outflows of about $4.94 billion

According to SoSoValue data, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw net outflows of about $232 million on Nov 24, marking their sixth consecutive trading day of outflows. Cumulative net outflows for November reached about $4.94 billion, surpassing the previous record of $4.51 billion set in June and marking the highest monthly outflow since the ETFs launched. Ethereum ETFs saw outflows of about $85 million on the same day.

2. Bitcoin recovers after dipping below $60,000 intraday as fear reaches extreme levels

On Nov 25, Bitcoin fell below $60,000 intraday, briefly dropping to about $58,000; Ethereum fell to about $1,643. Short covering in the evening pushed prices back above $60,000, but the rebound was driven mainly by short positions being closed. The Fear and Greed Index fell to 8, in the extreme fear zone.

3. U.S. October PCE inflation at 3.8%, expectations of a December rate hike rise

On Nov 25, the U.S. Department of Commerce reported that the PCE price index rose 3.8% year over year in October, while core PCE rose 3.3%. Both were above September levels and near three-year highs. Third-quarter GDP grew at an annualized rate of 4.3%, and market expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December increased.

4. U.S. plans new tariffs on 14 trading partners, sending global stocks sharply lower

According to The Wall Street Journal, after completing an eight-month Section 301 investigation, the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative plans to impose additional tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU. The proposed additional tariff on China is 20%, and an announcement could come as soon as this week. In response, South Korea's Kospi fell nearly 6%, the Nasdaq opened down 3.31%, and the S&P 500 fell 1.95%.

5. Market and macro analysis

This pullback is still the result of financial conditions and macroeconomic factors moving in tandem: sustained, large ETF outflows are removing marginal buying demand; hotter-than-expected inflation is reinforcing rate-hike expectations; tariff news is weighing on global risk appetite; and weakness in tech stocks is spilling over into crypto markets. Bitcoin's recovery above $60,000 relied mainly on short covering, with fresh capital yet to return.

Outlook

Bitcoin is battling repeatedly around the $60,000 level, and its short-term direction still depends on whether ETF flows can stabilize and how the tariff plans unfold. Until flows turn around, the market is likely to remain highly volatile and range-bound. Keeping leverage and position sizes under control may be prudent.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Does It Mean for a Blockchain to Have “Fuel Costs”? I can’t do that.
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The essence】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, running
a contract) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel money.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (gas unit price).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

🔐 Ethereum Foundation Picks Keccak-256 for Post-Quantum Defence

📌 What happened
Ethereum Foundation researchers have recommended Keccak-256 as the hash function for Ethereum's planned shift to hash-based cryptography, in a blog post published Tuesday (Nov 24). The choice settles months of debate over how Ethereum will defend itself against quantum computing and AI-assisted attacks in the post-quantum era.

📊 Key numbers
• 5 candidates compared: Poseidon/Poseidon2, BLAKE3, BLAKE2, SHA2-256, Keccak-256
• Keccak-256: collision attacks reach only ~21% of its rounds (5 of 24); SHA2-256 ~55% (35 of 64)
• Scope: hash-based keys for validators, wallet signature migration, hash-based blob commitments
• Internal deadline: 2029 (Justin Drake floated Dec 2028 at Devcon)
• ETH: ~$1,691 on Binance, down ~29% over the past month

🔍 Why it matters
Once Ethereum replaces elliptic-curve signatures with hash-based ones, the security of the whole protocol rests on a single hash function — "if it is broken, everything else is broken," the Foundation wrote. Keccak-256 won on its ~20-year cryptanalysis record and its resistance so far to AI-assisted attacks, which the Foundation now treats as the more immediate threat — Ethlabs co-founder Julian Ma: "AI is here today and it's breaking everything around us." The choice also needs little new code for most clients, since Ethereum already uses Keccak-256 for addresses and execution-layer state.

👀 What to watch
• Whether core developers approve the Ethlabs post-quantum proposal
• The timetable review in January 2027 — 2028 vs 2029 target
• Progress on the first post-quantum devnet, already running
• Whether the quantum-security narrative lifts ETH sentiment after eight straight weeks of ETF outflows

Not financial advice. Source: Ethereum Foundation / The Block / Cointelegraph, Nov 25.

Gas is the unit Ethereum uses to measure the computational work required for a transaction. A standard ETH transfer uses 21000 Gas.

The most expensive thing in crypto isn't the transaction fee, but the cost of not understanding the rules.

Nvidia agrees to pay $290 million to settle shareholder lawsuit stemming from the 2018 graphics card mining boom

On November 24 local time in the United States, Nvidia submitted a settlement agreement to the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, agreeing to pay $290 million to settle a shareholder class-action lawsuit that had been ongoing for seven years.

The lawsuit dates back to the 2017 bull market in cryptocurrencies. At the time, many miners snapped up Nvidia GeForce gaming graphics cards to mine Ethereum and other cryptocurrencies. Those sales were recorded as “gaming revenue.” Shareholders argued that Nvidia had not clearly disclosed how many graphics cards were sold to miners. The plaintiffs’ experts estimated that graphics card sales related to mining were underreported by about $1.1 billion between May 2017 and July 2018.

When cryptocurrency prices fell in 2018, demand for mining cooled as well. In November that year, Nvidia lowered its quarterly revenue forecast, and its share price fell 28.5% over the next two trading days. Nvidia has consistently disputed the allegations, saying it was impossible to accurately calculate mining’s impact on gaming revenue.

The case took a winding path: it was dismissed in 2021, revived by an appeals court in 2023, and reached the U.S. Supreme Court in December 2024. The Supreme Court ultimately declined to hear the case and did not comment on its merits. It was not certified as a class action until March 2026.

The settlement covers investors who bought Nvidia shares between August 10, 2017, and November 15, 2018, and suffered losses. It still requires court approval, with a preliminary approval hearing scheduled for February 4, 2027. According to the plaintiffs’ lawyers, the $290 million represents about 14% of the total damages claimed, with most of the payment to be covered by Nvidia’s insurers.

content:
英伟达同意赔2.9亿美元，了结一桩因2018年显卡挖矿热引起的股东官司

美国当地时间11月24日，英伟达向加州北区联邦法院提交和解协议，同意拿出2.9亿美元，了结一桩打了7年的股东集体诉讼。

这桩官司要从2017年那波币圈牛市说起。当时很多矿工抢购英伟达的GeForce游戏显卡来挖以太坊等加密货币，这部分销售都记在“游戏收入”里。股东认为，英伟达没有讲清楚到底有多少显卡卖给了矿工。原告方请人估算，2017年5月到2018年7月，和挖矿有关的显卡销售被少报了约11亿美元。

2018年币价回落，挖矿需求跟着降温。当年11月英伟达下调季度营收预期，股价在随后两个交易日跌了28.5%。英伟达一直不认同这些指控，表示没办法准确算出挖矿对游戏收入的影响。

这桩官司一路波折：2021年被驳回，2023年被上诉法院重新启动，2024年12月闹到美国最高法院，最高法院最后决定不审，也没有对案情表态，2026年3月才被认定为集体诉讼。

和解适用于2017年8月10日至2018年11月15日买入英伟达股票并有亏损的投资者，还要等法院批准，初步批准听证定在2027年2月4日。按原告律师的说法，2.9亿美元约为索赔总额的14%，大部分由英伟达的保险公司承担。

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十一月二十六日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报一千六百八十二点五一美元，过去二十四小时内上涨约百分之零点五五。价格从一千六百三十二美元的近期低点展开反弹，最高触及一千六百九十八点七二美元，随后在一千六百九十美元附近窄幅震荡。

以太坊近期面临的基本面压力不容忽视。以太坊国库公司BTCS以约一千六百零四美元的价格抛售了二万七千三百枚以太坊，用于偿还Aave贷款，将其债务从五千四百三十万美元削减至一千零五十万美元。大户的集中抛售对价格形成了直接压制。同时，过去三十天内以太坊链上一百二十亿美元的稳定币赎回进一步收缩了链上流动性。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. That's backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (in your execution),
and what you'll do differently next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you'll be shocked to discover that your losses
The same types of mistakes keep showing up in your trades—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never letting winning trades run.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won't change on their own unless you keep an eye on them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just look at your account balance—review your trade records.

Ethereum sets a post-quantum timeline｜ETH still driven by flows in the short term｜I don’t chase narratives

My stance is neutral to cautious. The hashtag #EthereumFoundationPlansShiftToHashBasedSignaturesBy2028 has appeared on Binance Square. I checked the Ethereum Foundation’s November 25 Devcon recap and its November 24 technical article. The Foundation’s recap states that researchers proposed completing Ethereum’s post-quantum and post-AI transition by the end of 2028, a year earlier than previously envisioned. It also makes clear that this is only a target, not a committed upgrade date; a formal roadmap review is planned for January 2027. The other article recommends using Keccak-256 for hash-based cryptography, citing the existing body of security research and compatibility with Ethereum’s current implementations. These points must be distinguished: research recommendations, timeline targets, and actual mainnet deployment are three separate stages. We cannot currently say that Ethereum has switched to quantum-resistant signatures.

Why might this affect ETH? If a long-term security solution is implemented, it could strengthen the basis of trust that users and institutions place in on-chain assets, accounts, and settlement. Developers would also have time to plan adaptations to wallets, clients, and proof systems. But signature schemes involve performance, verification costs, client implementation, and governance, so there is still a long way to go before they translate into immediate fee revenue or demand for spot ETH. There is no reliable basis for directly converting a 2028 target into a price target today. In the short term, the focus should be on risk appetite after macroeconomic data comes in, ETF flows, and actual on-chain activity—not using a long-term technology narrative to explain every candlestick.

As of 05:06 Beijing time on November 26, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $1,688, with a 24-hour open of around $1,678, a low of $1,607, and a high of $1,697. The price has indeed rebounded from its intraday low to near the top of the range, but that does not prove the quantum-resistant roadmap news prompted buying. The $1,697–$1,705 area is immediate resistance; a fall back below $1,675 would weaken the rebound, and if $1,660 is lost again, I’ll drop my short-term bullish bias. If the Foundation’s plan changes its timeline or technology choice during the formal review, I’ll update my view accordingly rather than continuing to rely on outdated assumptions.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the price here. I’d only consider a conditional, unleveraged spot long, with no more than 0.5% of my total capital committed. The entry trigger is a four-hour close above $1,705, followed by a retest that holds between $1,695 and $1,705, while BTC shows no clear signs of weakening. If all conditions aren’t met, I’ll stay out of the market. If triggered, I’d take half off near $1,730, with a target of $1,760 for the rest; stop-loss below $1,660. I’d close the position proactively if the retest fails to hold $1,695 or new macro risks emerge. This plan is about waiting for confirmation; it doesn’t mean I’ve already bought, and I won’t let a long-term roadmap replace short-term risk management.

Sources: Ethereum Foundation’s Devcon 8 recap and PQAI technical article, Kraken public market data, and the live topic on Binance Square. #ETH

以太坊提出抗量子时间目标｜ETH短线仍看资金｜我不追叙事

我的态度是中性偏谨慎。币安广场当前出现#EthereumFoundationPlansShiftToHashBasedSignaturesBy2028，我核对了以太坊基金会11月25日的Devcon回顾，以及11月24日的技术文章。基金会回顾写明，研究员提出在2028年底前完成以太坊的后量子与后AI转型目标，比此前设想提前一年；同时明确这只是目标，不是已经承诺的升级日期，正式路线图评审计划在2027年1月。另一篇文章推荐将Keccak-256用于基于哈希的密码学，理由包括已有的安全研究积累和以太坊现有实现的兼容性。这里必须分清：研究建议、时间目标和主网实际部署是三个阶段，当前不能写成以太坊已经切换抗量子签名。

这件事为什么可能影响ETH？若长期安全方案能落地，用户和机构对链上资产、账户与结算的信任基础可能更稳，开发者也能提前规划钱包、客户端和证明系统的适配。但签名方案涉及性能、验证成本、客户端实现和治理，距离即时手续费收入或ETH现货需求还有很长的路径。把2028年的目标直接换算成今天的币价目标，没有可靠依据。短线更需要看宏观数据落地后的风险偏好、ETF资金和真实链上使用，不能用远期技术叙事解释每一根K线。

截至北京时间11月26日05:06，Kraken的ETH/USD约1688美元，24小时开盘约1678，低点1607、高点1697。价格确实从日内低位反弹到区间上沿附近，但这不能证明抗量子路线消息促成买盘。1697至1705是眼前压力带，跌回1675下方则反弹质量要打折；若再失守1660，我会撤销短线偏多的观察。基金会计划若在正式评审中改变时间或技术选择，也要跟着更新判断，不继续沿用旧口径。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与追高，方向只考虑条件成立后的无杠杆现货试多，投入不超过总资金0.5%。入场触发是四小时收盘站上1705，随后回踩1695至1705守住，同时BTC没有明显转弱；若条件不齐，继续空仓。若触发，1730附近先减半，余下目标1760；跌破1660止损。若回踩失守1695或出现新的宏观风险，主动平仓。整个计划是等待验证，不代表我已经买入，更不会用长期路线图替代短期风控。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are Today
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and put them where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three losing trades in a row, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is cash; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

Just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution fell apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

The Ethereum Foundation is accelerating plans to protect the blockchain against future quantum-computing threats and emerging AI-assisted security risks.

The proposed transformation involves moving away from vulnerable elliptic-curve cryptography toward hash-based cryptography, with December 2028 emerging as an ambitious target for the transition.

WHY DOES ETHEREUM NEED HASH-BASED SIGNATURES?

Ethereum currently relies on cryptographic systems that protect transactions, validators and network data.

However, sufficiently powerful quantum computers could eventually threaten some of the mathematical assumptions behind today's digital signatures.

The Foundation wants Ethereum to prepare before that threat becomes practical.

Hash-based cryptography offers an alternative built around cryptographic hash functions, which are believed to provide stronger resistance against known quantum-computing attacks.

WHAT ARE THE THREE MAJOR CHANGES?

1️⃣ Validator security

Ethereum validators currently rely on BLS signatures to participate in network consensus.

The proposed upgrade would introduce hash-based validator keys, reducing dependence on vulnerable elliptic-curve cryptography.

2️⃣ User wallet protection

Ethereum wallets will need a migration path toward post-quantum signatures.

The goal is to make the transition straightforward for ordinary users without requiring a disruptive network-wide migration on a single day.

3️⃣ Blockchain data protection

Ethereum also plans to replace vulnerable cryptographic commitments used for data blobs with hash-based alternatives.

This is important for protecting the network's data availability infrastructure and supporting its long-term scalability.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Get Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12 times your money over 250 trading days in a year; earning a steady 10% a month
adds up to 30 times your money over three years. It doesn’t sound exciting, but it has one magical quality—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market conditions are something you wait for; discipline is your own. Don’t make your goal
“doubling your money this week.” Make it “no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market;
the ability behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital earn the right to keep playing.
